name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy has been actively releasing updates through late October and November 2026. The latest release, v2.37.0 (Nov 2, 2026), improves UnifiedPush multi-server support with subscriber-based rate limiting shared via the database, adds Retry-After and RateLimit headers to HTTP 429 responses, and optimizes memory usage for one-off visitors. Earlier releases (v2.36.0, v2.35.0, v2.34.0) added persistent daily limits across restarts with PostgreSQL sharing, an experimental local admin socket, tier change improvements, and cluster/load balancer support. Release notes are available at https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL (client) — dual-licensed; check repository for exact terms
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in October–November 2026 with active bug fixes and features
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — user accounts, tiers, token-based auth, and access control are supported

breaking_excerpts: v2.36.0: Everyone's daily counts start over at upgrade — stats_* columns of the user table are zeroed and no longer used
v2.36.0: Servers sharing a PostgreSQL database must keep their clocks in sync (NTP); visitors without a tier have a daily e-mail limit again
v2.37.0: UnifiedPush push to a topic with no subscriber for 4 days now returns 410 Gone (error 41002) instead of 507, causing app servers like Mastodon to remove the expired subscription

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise supports a massive number of notification targets in one library but is a notification dispatcher rather than a standalone pub-sub server.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notification mirroring and file sharing but is closed-source and has heavily restricted its free tier over time.

alternatives.name: Ntopng / Alertmanager (Prometheus)
alternatives.review: Alertmanager is a powerful self-hosted alert routing system but is purpose-built for Prometheus metrics alerting rather than general-purpose script-driven notifications.
